name: Eric Slifka
current_role: President, CEO and Chairman of the Board, Global Partners LP (NYSE: GLP); named chairman in 2025 succeeding his uncle Richard Slifka
profile: Eric Slifka runs Global Partners LP, a Massachusetts-based fuel distribution, terminal and convenience-store MLP. He grew up in the family's home heating oil business with his father Fred Slifka, became COO of Global Companies in 1998, President and CEO in 2003, and led the 2005 IPO as an MLP; the company has since grown more than tenfold.
interesting_fact: He led Global Partners' 2005 IPO as a master limited partnership; since then the company has grown more than tenfold and paid more than $1 billion in distributions to unitholders.
deep_cut_fact: He learned the business hands-on from childhood alongside his father at the family's retail home heating oil company, later working terminals, bulk operations, vessel movements and truck loading racks; he sits on the National Petroleum Council and the board of the Energy Policy Research Foundation.
notes: Energy-relevant guest (fuel terminals, energy transition). Reid Lamberty (Senior Communications Advisor) is the current media contact on a 2026 release; media@ and IR emails are from a 2024 Business Wire release (summarised by search, not fetched). Chairman appointment reported by C-Store Dive June 2025: https://www.cstoredive.com/news/global-partners-eric-slifka-chairman/749842/

name: Richard Marko
current_role: CEO, ESET (Bratislava-based cybersecurity company), since January 2011
profile: Slovak computer scientist who joined ESET during his university studies, co-authored the ESET NOD32 antivirus scanning engine, became CTO in 2008 and CEO in 2011. His wealth stems from his stake in ESET. In May 2026 he announced a EUR 40m investment in AI-powered cybersecurity at ESET World 2026 in Berlin, stressing European tech sovereignty.
interesting_fact: Under Marko, ESET said in 2026 it had scanned nearly 800,000 unique AI agent 'skills' since March 2026, flagging ~25,000 as suspicious and blocking 3,000+ as malicious; he argues cybersecurity 'cannot depend entirely on models controlled by Big Tech'.
deep_cut_fact: He began as chief software architect of ESET's scanning core and co-authored the NOD32 engine; per Starmus, in 2002 he developed an AI-based heuristic method that helped counter email-borne virus outbreaks, later extended into malware 'DNA' detection. He also sits on the board of the ESET Foundation (ESET Science Award).
notes: Rebecca Kiely is Director of Global PR and Communication (best global route); pr@eset.com is the North America press team. Repeatedly voted Slovakia's most respected CEO in PwC/Forbes surveys. Regular speaker (Starmus, GLOBSEC). Good AI/sovereignty angle.

name: Zhao Zhiya
current_role: Co-founder of Kuang-Chi (光启); since Nov 2022 responsible for fundamental/frontier research at the controlling-shareholder group level (left listed Kuang-Chi Technologies' board and GM post)
profile: Dr. Zhao Zhiya is one of five founders of Shenzhen-based Kuang-Chi, a metamaterials company whose founding team came out of a Duke University research lab before 2010. He served as president/general manager and director of the listed Kuang-Chi Technologies until November 2022, when he resigned to lead fundamental, frontier research at the controlling-shareholder group.
interesting_fact: In 2020 he said Kuang-Chi aimed to be 'the Qian Xuesen of the new era', projecting about RMB 1bn of metamaterial orders that year and capacity of 48 tons by year-end, insisting the company was 'not drawing pie in the sky'.
deep_cut_fact: Per the company's Nov 2022 SZSE filing, he stepped down as director and GM of Kuang-Chi Technologies not to leave but to take on 'foundational, pioneering research' at the controlling-shareholder group level.
notes: Low public profile since 2022; no personal channels found. Route would be via Kuang-Chi (光启) corporate/IR channels (not verified in this pass). Founding team linked to Duke University metamaterials lab per The Paper.

profile: Li Chunrong chairs Jinling Sports, a Zhangjiagang (Jiangsu)-based, A-share-listed maker of high-end sports equipment that also does venue construction, public fitness and event services. name: Wu Zhenshan
current_role: Chairman, Tian Shan Development (Holding) Ltd. (HKEX: 2118), Shijiazhuang/Hebei property developer (as of June 2022 filing)

name: Luo Qiang
current_role: Co-founder and shareholder of Guangdong Haid Group (海大集团, SZSE: 002311), the feed and aquaculture company; former general manager (current title not confirmed)
profile: Luo Qiang (born 1969) is one of five natural-person founders of Haid Group, China's large animal-feed and aquaculture-inputs company. A 1992 freshwater-fisheries graduate of Huazhong Agricultural University, he founded Guangzhou Haid in July 1998 with partners and was Haid's general manager from November 2004, per the 2009 IPO prospectus.
interesting_fact: When Haid's holding vehicle Haid Industrial was set up on 8 Jan 2004, Luo Qiang was one of five founders (with Xue Hua, Xu Yingzhuo, Tan Lili and Jiang Xiewu), holding 4.5% of the controlling shareholder at IPO.
deep_cut_fact: He studied freshwater fisheries (淡水渔业) at Huazhong Agricultural University, graduating in 1992, and worked in feed and fish farming before co-founding Guangzhou Haid in July 1998; the prospectus says he 'long stood on the front line' of operations as GM of several group companies.
notes: Not the Hainan University researcher of the same name. Current role at Haid not confirmed (not named in recent 2025 board announcements seen via search). Very low profile; route via Haid Group IR/board secretary.

name: Pan Jiangen
current_role: Chairman, General Manager and Chief Scientist, Hangzhou Everfine Photo-E-Info Co. (远方信息, formerly 远方光电; SZSE: 300306)
profile: Pan Jiangen (born 1965), a professor-level senior engineer trained in optoelectronic measurement at Zhejiang University, founded Hangzhou Everfine Instruments in 1994 and Everfine Photo-E-Info in 2003, which makes optical/photoelectric test and measurement instruments. He directly and indirectly controls about 48.65% of the listed company and was reappointed GM in Sept 2025.
interesting_fact: He is both chairman and 'chief scientist' of the company he founded, and directly and indirectly controls 48.65% of it (Sept 2025 filing).
deep_cut_fact: Before becoming an entrepreneur he stayed on at Zhejiang University in 1989 to do research and teaching after graduating in optoelectronic measurement technology and instrument engineering, then founded Hangzhou Everfine Instruments in 1994.
notes: board@everfine.cn is the board office/securities representative contact published in the company's Sept 2025 announcement. Co-listed wealth with Meng Xin (shareholder).

name: Wu Xianliang
current_role: Former controlling shareholder of Suzhou Kede Education Technology (科德教育, SZSE: 300192; formerly Suzhou Kingswood Printing Ink); retains ~3% after a January 2026 share sale
profile: Wu Xianliang (born 1978, Suzhou) built his fortune as controlling shareholder of Suzhou Kingswood, a Shenzhen-listed offset printing-ink maker (founded 2003) that later added vocational education and renamed itself Kede Education. In January 2026 he agreed to transfer 23.57% of the company to Shenzhen Huaxin Weilai Investment and an Orient asset-management vehicle, cutting his stake from 26.57% to 3%.
interesting_fact: His January 2026 deal handed control of the listed ink-and-education company to Shenzhen Huaxin Weilai (华芯未来), with Zhou Qichao becoming the new actual controller; the first instalment alone was about RMB 263m.
notes: Birth year 1978 from ID prefix in the SZSE disclosure. Earlier titles (chairman/GM of Kingswood from 2008, roles at other ink firms) come only from aggregator profiles via search, unverified. Company IR phone per stockanalysis: +86 512 6537 3047. No personal channels.
